title: 2022 Bowman #40 Adley Rutschman Baltimore Orioles Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is an incredible Adley Rutschman Rookie Card, numbered 40 in the set, featuring him in his Baltimore Orioles uniform. The card is part of the 2022 Topps Bowman set and is a must-have for any sports card collector. It is an authentic, officially licensed product, manufactured in the United States by Topps.

The card is a base set card and is categorized as a rookie card, making it even more valuable to collectors. It is a Major League (MLB) football card and is autographed with authentication from Topps. This card is a great addition to any collection and will surely impress any fan of the sport.
